programme.title: The Great British Theft?
programme.desc: The Parthenon, the crown jewel of Athens, is a 2,500-year-old UNESCO World Heritage Site. Two centuries ago, Lord Elgin dismantled nearly half of its sculptures under false pretense and shipped them back to the British Museum. Today, the Acropolis Museum holds only a fraction of its originals. In this documentary, CGTN visits both sites to pose a candid question. Were his actions in the spirit of preservation, or was it just plunder.
